references.text: The spies followed Rahab's advice and hid in the mountains for three days until their pursuers had returned.
Lot received similar instructions to flee to the mountains to escape destruction.
Moses fled to Midian to escape persecution and hid there for a long time.
Jonathan warned David that Saul was seeking to kill him, and David hid to escape his pursuers.
David hid in the mountains of the wilderness to escape Saul's pursuit.
Obadiah hid one hundred prophets in caves to protect them from persecution.
Rahab is mentioned as an example of faith, she who welcomed the spies and helped them escape.
